data.body: **[P2] Avoid invoking custom descriptors while inspecting retained state.** `object.__getattribute__` still invokes data descriptors, while `type(value).__mro__`, `vars(cls)`, and iteration of the mutable `__slots__` attribute can dispatch to user-defined code. A transformed object with a blocking metaclass, property shadowing a slot, or replaced `__slots__` iterable can therefore stall the checkpoint hook. Inspect exact class dictionaries and member descriptors without normal attribute lookup, or reject such objects; add blocking descriptor and slots regressions.
